validation: Artifact must declare layer and platform.
Components must include anatomy, states, accessibility, engineering, and agent spec.
Patterns must include journey, screens, metrics, research, engineering, and agent spec.
Templates must include context, IA, flows, data, permissions, implementation, and agent spec.
Charts must include accessible text summaries.
Maps must include permission-denied and fallback-list behavior.
Lottie cannot be required for task comprehension.
Material Symbols cannot replace accessible labels for rare or risky actions.
